title: Petinsurance Metric2 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petinsurance:metric2 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for petinsurance metric2 (2) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for petinsurance metric2 (2) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises the smoothed week-long trend in your value from petinsurance metric2 (2).
